The Agent Development Lifecycle

One workflow for building an AI agent with Google's Agents CLI: scaffold, run, evaluate, deploy, observe, and loop back. A LangChain extension swaps six framework-specific commands and leaves the rest native, so ADK and LangChain agents share one lifecycle and one deploy path. Tap any block; play the lifecycle; switch between agent types.

Swipe sideways to see the whole map.
Tap a block to learn what it does, or press ▶ Play.

The agent lifecycle

The same five stages for ADK and LangChain agents: Scaffold → Run → Eval → Deploy → Observe, and production lessons feed the next scaffold.

🧩Framework-aware devSwap only what the framework owns.
📋One eval standardSame dataset, same grading.
🚀One deploy pathNo second pipeline per framework.
⚖️Framework choiceAn engineering decision, not a penalty.

⚠️ The commands, counts (24 CLI commands, 6 swapped: 4 replaced, 2 refused) and the extension file name follow the infographic; the Agents CLI and its extensions were marked experimental, and we could not check every command against Google's documentation from our sandbox. Explanations are ours. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site, and Claude Code appears in this diagram as one of the coding agents. Google is an investor in Anthropic.
